title: The Impact of Anisotropic Covariance Structure on the Training Dynamics and Generalization Error of Linear Networks
abstract: arXiv:2601.06961v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The success of deep neural networks largely depends on the statistical structure of the training data. While learning dynamics and generalization on isotropic data are well-established, the impact of pronounced anisotropy on these crucial aspects is not yet fully understood. We examine the impact of data anisotropy, represented by a spiked covariance structure, a canonical yet tractable model, on the learning dynamics and generalization error of a two-layer linear network in a linear regression setting. Our analysis reveals that the learning dynamics proceed in two distinct phases, governed initially by the input-output correlation and subsequently by other principal directions of the data structure. Furthermore, we derive an analytical expression for the generalization error, quantifying how the alignment of the spike structure of the data with the learning task improves performance. translated_title: 各向异性协方差结构对线性网络训练动力学和泛化误差的影响
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络的成功在很大程度上依赖于训练数据的统计结构。尽管各向同性数据上的学习动力学和泛化性能已得到充分研究，但显著的各向异性对这些关键方面的影响尚未被完全理解。我们研究了数据各向异性的影响——以尖峰协方差结构这一经典且易于处理的模型来表示——在线性回归设定下对两层线性网络的学习动力学和泛化误差的作用。我们的分析表明，学习动力学分为两个明显的阶段：最初由输入-输出相关性主导，随后由数据结构的其他主方向主导。此外，我们推导出了泛化误差的解析表达式，量化了数据的尖峰结构与学习任务的对齐程度如何改善性能。我们的发现为这一领域提供了深入的理论洞见。
tldr: 本研究揭示了数据各向异性（尖峰协方差结构）使两层线性网络的学习动力学分为两阶段——先由输入-输出相关性主导，后由数据主方向主导，并推导出泛化误差的解析表达式，量化了数据尖峰结构与任务对齐程度对性能的提升作用。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that data anisotropy (spiked covariance structure) drives two-phase learning dynamics in two-layer linear networks—first governed by input-output correlation, then by other principal data directions—and derives an analytical expression for the generalization error, quantifying how the alignment between data spikes and the learning task improves performance.
